stem.en: In a high jump event, the athlete lands on a thick mat or a sand bed. Why?

text.en: The mat reduces the weight of the athlete.

feedback.en: The weight of the athlete does not change.

text.en: The mat removes the force of friction.

feedback.en: The mat protects by making the stop slower, not by removing friction.

text.en: She stops more slowly, so the force is smaller.

feedback.en: Right. The soft mat makes the stop take a longer time, so the force on her body is smaller.

explanation.en: On a soft mat, the athlete takes a longer time to stop. Her acceleration is smaller, so the force on her body is smaller, and she is less likely to be hurt.

hints.en: Is it the same reason as for the airbag?
